Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN
Topic 4.1: Greatest

SECTION 1: WELCOME

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Greatest: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.

3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Greatest?
